english.note: Use this for the other option or proposal when contrasting it with one already mentioned.

exampleSentences.english: If you don't like this one, we can try another alternative.
exampleSentences.traditional: 如果你唔鍾意呢個，我哋可以試另一個。
exampleSentences.jyutping: jyu4 gwo2 nei5 m4 zung1 ji3 ni1 go3 ngo5 dei6 ho2 ji5 si3 ling6 jat1 go3

english.note: Use this for the other one of two alternatives or complementary things.

exampleSentences.english: You take this one, and I’ll take the opposite one.
exampleSentences.jyutping: nei5 gaan2 ni1 go3 ngo5 gaan2 ling6 jat1 go3
